note: Itawamba County (FIPS 28057) publishes no queryable zoning district layer. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the web found none for the county or its cities (Fulton, Tremont, Mantachie, Dorsey, Marietta, which have their own zoning per mississippistateauthority.com, but none publish a GIS layer). Only commercial parcel products (Regrid, Acres, Rockford) carry zoning fields; those are licensed, not public. A county GIS parcel layer found (GDITAdmin Itawamba_parcels2020) would not serve; the Itawamba_MS CommunitySystems service requires a token.
